name: Positive Recursive Teaching Dimension of the Three-Code Class
proof: Remove $011$ and $101$ first, using their positive one-point teaching samples $(x_1,1)$ and $(x_2,1)$, each unique among the current class. The remaining $000$ is removed with the empty sample. Thus positive RTD is at most one; it cannot be zero on a non-singleton class. Hence $\mathrm{RTD}^{+}=1$.
references: Direct calculation from the class definition; see \cite{fallat2023batch}.
